def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved bi-variate empirical function for log10(|ID|/A)."""
    a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6 = parameters
    sqrt_gate = np.sqrt(gate_voltage_abs) - a1
    sqrt_drain = np.sqrt(drain_voltage_abs) - a2
    
    first_order_gate = a3 * sqrt_gate
    first_order_drain = a4 * sqrt_drain
    second_order_gate = a5 * (sqrt_gate)**2
    second_order_drain = a6 * (sqrt_drain)**2
